question: What claim about transmission requires the teaching concerning the Mothers to have been told again by the sky-movers to the goddess and the beloved?
premises: A teaching concerning the Mothers exists.
The tellers are the sky-movers, addressed to the goddess and the beloved.
inference: Again, the sky-movers have told the teaching concerning the Mothers, O goddess and beloved one.
plain_english: Again, O goddess, O beloved one, the teaching concerning the Mothers has been told by the sky-movers.
